t: This is Marlborough Place, a residential street in St John's Wood, in the City of Westminster. It runs from Hamilton Terrace in the west to the Finchley Road in the east. Like many British streets, its name comes from the Dukes of Marlborough, in particular John Churchill, the first Duke, a soldier and statesman who rose through courage and diplomatic skill and is known for never having lost a battle. June Marsham-Townshend is also recorded as having lived on this street.
